content: यन्तृ {%a.%} [यम्-तृच्] .²1 Restraining, curbing, controlling. .²2 Guiding, directing. --{%m.%} .²1 A director, governor, ruler. .²2 A driver (as of an elephant, carriage <ab>&c.</ab>), coachman, charioteer; यन्ता गजस्याभ्यपतद् गजस्थम् <ls>R. 7. 37</ls>; अथ यन्तारमादिश्य धुर्यान् विश्रामयेति सः <ls n="R.">1. 54</ls>; <ls>Bhāg. 8. 11. 17</ls>; <ls>Ki. 7. 32</ls>; सव्योऽपि सानुनयमाकलनाय यन्त्रा <ls>Śi.</ls> .²3 An elephant-driver or rider.
